title: T6 · Orchestrator out-of-band investigation entry point
description:
T6 · Orchestrator out-of-band investigation entry point

Add `runInvestigationFromTrigger(specs)` to `src/orchestrator.ts`. See design doc §5.4.

* Build a `ClassificationResult`-shaped payload from the synthesized specs (bypass the LLM Classify stage) and drive the existing `runInvestigate → runDecide → runSelectedResponseStage` chain.
* Record a `run` with `trigger_source = 'alarm'` and link back to the originating `alarm_triggers` row(s).
* Reconcile through **all three** dedupe layers (`reconcileObservations` / `canonicalObservationKey`, mandatory-spec `specDedupeKey`/`incidentCoversSpec`, and read-side) so an alarm-born incident merges with any report-born counterpart.
* Respect the same `investigateInFlight` guard used by the scheduled tick.

**Done when:** an injected trigger produces an Investigate→Decide→Verify run tagged `alarm`, and a matching report-born incident in the same window dedupes to one incident.
